## Pull request overview Removes previously-included “Mock” ISA spec artifacts from `spec/std/isa` and eliminates the ISA Explorer generator’s special-casing that hid a `Mock` profile release, aligning generated ISA Explorer tables with the remaining real profile releases. **Changes:** - Delete `Mock`/`Xmock` spec YAML fixtures (profile family, proc cert class, extension, and a set of `MOCK_*` parameters). - Remove the `sorted_profile_releases` filter that dropped a profile release named `"Mock"` from ISA Explorer output. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 26 out of 26 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.
